versions.short: The resolution designates September 2026 as National Spinal Cord Injury Awareness Month and expresses the Senate's support for the month's goals. It also backs continued research into better treatments, therapies, and a cure for spinal cord injuries, along with clinical trials of new therapies offering hope to people living with paralysis. Finally, it commends the organizations, researchers, doctors, volunteers, and others across the country who work to improve the lives of people with spinal cord injuries and their families.
